reason: Long business documentaries pull a 121K median on niche channels and small channels hit 100K+, at the highest RPM band we have; it needs a footage fetcher and a documentary editor built first.
conditions: Build a licensed media fetcher before samples: Pexels, Pixabay, Commons (video too) and SEC EDGAR, with a per-channel licence log; the render fails on an asset missing from the log.
Build a documentary editor in Remotion: footage, slow-pan photos, our motion graphics and document/headline props on one timeline.

Settled stories only (court filings, regulator findings, company filings, reputable outlets); every accusation attributed on screen to its source; no identifiable stock person on a fraud or scandal beat (Pexels licence).
Original script, our own graphics and real variation per video, against the inauthentic-content rule (applied to the whole channel since 15 Jul 2025).
Long videos 15-25 min (the best-performing band), 2 a week; Shorts are reach only.
Never voice a real person's quote with TTS: show it as text or a document.
for: Long videos on 19 on-niche channels: 121,440 median views (90 days, 339 videos); 15-25 min band 158,096 median.
Small channels win: 8 of 12 on-niche channels under 50K subs had a 100K+ long video in 90 days (Fortune & Fall, 6.5K subs: 2.28M on one video).
Highest money of our niches: business/finance doc RPM estimated $5-12 (OutlierKit, Stan; estimates) and sponsors common (NetSuite, Surfshark, ShipStation).
against: New kit needed: no footage fetcher or documentary editor exists yet (build items).
YouTube's bar doubles to 8,000 watch hours on 1 Feb 2027 (official); we will very likely join under the new bar.
Shorts are weak for money: on-niche Shorts median 18,210, small channels 7,246, and Shorts RPM $0.05-0.20 (estimates); scandal stories carry legal risk and need strict sourcing.

earnings.assumptions: Estimates, not facts. 2 long (15-25 min) a week + 1 Short a day. Partner programme at 8,000 watch hours (rule from 1 Feb 2027): about 60K long views at ~8 min watched each, reached in month 4-6 in 'likely', never in 'low'. Long RPM $6 likely ($5-12 band, OutlierKit/Stan estimates); Shorts ignored. m6 likely: ~25K long views/month after joining; m12 likely: ~200K long views/month (small-channel median 20,806 per video x 8-9 videos + some hits). High: one hit like Fortune & Fall's 2.28M views. Sponsors not counted.

demand.note: On-niche channels only (19 long, 16 Shorts). The raw scan's 54,124 long / 30,696 Shorts medians include news and entertainment channels the searches caught (CNN, NBC, WatchMojo, MX Player); 'direction' is the raw scan's long figure.

doable.look: Hybrid doc: licensed stock footage (Pexels, Pixabay, Prelinger), Commons/archival photos, EDGAR and court documents as props, our flat-kit charts, timelines and maps. Needs the fetcher and documentary editor (conditions 1-2). Renders in the cloud (no 3D).
doable.voice: Kokoro American narrator; the references are narrated documentaries, so a TTS narrator fits; a generic narrator needs no label (YouTube's synthetic-content rules cover realistic people and events).
doable.policy: Inauthentic content (whole channel) -> original scripts and variety. Advertiser-friendly: journalistic coverage of misconduct earns full ads; graphic deaths limited. Defamation: truth is the defence -> settled, attributed stories only. Licences: Pexels bans showing identifiable people in a bad light; Pixabay bans trademark-centred clips commercially; press kits are editorial-only (avoid); logos from Commons, identification only.

references.Company Man: the @companyman link resolved to a different 51-sub channel; the real Company Man (1.8M subs) came in through the searches: 13 long, 243,026 median
